exposure: Mode of delivery (Full dilatation caesarean section vs successful operative vaginal deliveries)
outcome: Rate of full dilatation caesarean section
cohort: Pregnancies resulting in singleton deliveries at or after 34 weeks gestation over a 10-year period and in 2015 at a tertiary referral unit
finding: Fetal head malposition was associated with a higher risk of full dilatation caesarean section, while maternal and fetal morbidity were similar between full dilatation caesarean sections and operative vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Fetal head malposition was associated with a higher risk of full dilatation caesarean section.
